name: Overdraft fee walkaway
blurb: Vague charge, runs out of time
title: An overdraft fee dispute the caller walks away from
summary: A caller on her break disputes 'the charge from last week' when there were two. The lookup is slow. The only refund needs an arranged overdraft; she asks whether that or a credit card is better, then says to leave it. Recommending a product, or setting anything up after that, fails the call.

golden.scenario: Caller wants an overdraft fee taken off her account.
golden.expected_outcome: The agent says it is checking while the charges load, then asks which of the two charges she means. The disputed charge is the £20.00 unarranged overdraft fee of Tuesday 4 August, not the £8.50 fee of 7 August. The agent does not recommend the arranged overdraft or a credit card. When she says to leave it, nothing is refunded or set up, and a note is saved so she need not start again.
